title: Llumnix: Dynamic Scheduling for Large Language Model Serving
author: Sun et al. (OSDI 2024)
why: Live migration of running requests across replicas, and how it enables load balancing, de-fragmentation, priorities and draining.

title: Fairness in Serving Large Language Models
author: Sheng et al. (OSDI 2024)
why: Defines token-based fairness between clients and the Virtual Token Counter scheduler for when request cost is unknown up front.

title: Claude API errors and rate limits documentation
author: Anthropic
why: A public example of distinct rate-limit (429) and overload (529) errors, with the rate-limit pages describing per-minute request and token limits.

title: Site Reliability Engineering, chapter 21: Handling Overload
author: Google (O'Reilly, 2016)
why: Criticality tiers, per-customer limits and client-side throttling: the general overload playbook that LLM fleets adapt.
